summary: Show objectives and budgets in the terminal UI usage pane, red when an objective is missed or a budget is nearly spent, with a chart of the selected row

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change; the pane reads slo.list and slo.history.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Client-only change. Against a daemon without the slo routes the pane says its daemon needs an update.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build removes the rows from the pane.
